quarterly_data.signal: Linde's 10-K: at December 31, 2025 the sale of gas backlog of large projects under construction was approximately $7.3 billion (the total estimated capital cost of large plants under construction). 2025 capital expenditures were $5,261 million, up $764 million from 2024, primarily for new plant and production equipment for backlog growth, with approximately 60% in the Americas segment and 21% in APAC. Linde estimates the consideration related to future minimum purchase requirements (company-wide, under on-site customers' long-term supply arrangements, durations up to thirty years) and plant sales from the Linde Engineering business (primarily fixed-price) at approximately $62 billion as of December 31, 2025; the amount excludes all on-site sales above minimum purchase requirements, and about half of the minimum-purchase revenue is expected to be earned in the next six years.
quarterly_data.figure: sale-of-gas backlog approximately $7.3 billion (December 31, 2025); 2025 capex $5,261 million (+$764 million); future minimum purchase requirements and plant sales approximately $62 billion (December 31, 2025)
